name: hatch-codogotchi
description: Codex-native skills that draw Codogotchi-compatible sprite atlases (Codex, Lite-Basic, Lite-Enhanced, and Son-of-Anton tiers) from a seed image, a text description, or an existing Codex sheet.

interface.longDescription: Hatch Codogotchi bundles five guided, grid-first skills plus a Python pipeline: image_gen draws each animation row as a single 4x2 grid (8 cells of 192x208) on a flat magenta (#FF00FF) chroma key, then slice_grid.py finds the real gutters between cells, shares one scale across the row, and emits an exact 1536x208 strip; compose_atlas.py stacks the rows into a WebP atlas, followed by slim QA (dimensions, grid, static-row detection, contact sheet, GIF previews). Chroma keying is intentionally left to the user via the dedicated Chroma Key Studio web tool (chromakeyremoval.vercel.app); a magenta key keeps the pet's own colors and green props cleanly separable. Produces Codogotchi-compatible sprite atlases for the required Codex Tier-1 sheet, the Lite-Basic and Lite-Enhanced alive/dead tiers, and the Son-of-Anton delivery-gate sheet.
defaultPrompt: Hatch a new Codogotchi pet from this seed image
Add the Lite-Basic spritesheet to my existing Codex pet
Generate the Son-of-Anton gate spritesheet for my pet
